messages:
alex_sales: Quick escalation: Vertex Labs POC failing intermittently. They use function-calls + JSON mode for catalog enrichment. Sometimes parser throws 'Unexpected token' because of trailing control chars at end of stream. They also saw 429s during a ramp. Need triage + Dedicated pricing + SQ answers (HSM/KMS, EU residency). Can eng & security help?

mira_engineer: can you paste a raw chunk and headers? which model variant?

alex_sales: pasted (redacted):

```
--chunk--
{"tool":"prod_extract","data":{"items":[{"id":"sku-9","name":"Gizmo"}]}}
\x00\xFF\n
parse error at pos 212
```
Headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tools-1.1-q6`, `x-client-id: vertex-45`

sam_oncall: 429s probably from parallel workers. Are they hitting /v1/stream? How many clients?

alex_sales: yes /v1/stream with 10 parallel workers.

leo_ml: model q6 path may add a short binary footer on EOF under heavy batching. We've had a similar streaming flush race. Two tracks: 1) assembler sanitizer to drop non-utf8 tail and ensure last char is } or ]; 2) generate a fallback JSON wrapper when sanitizer strips bytes so client still receives valid JSON (e.g., {"_rw_tool_malformed":true,"raw_b64":"..."}).

mira_engineer: agree. I'll patch stream assembler to trim invalid suffix and to emit fallback wrapper when configured. Add route flag `tool_stream_fallback=base64` behind feature gate.

tess_security: SQ asks: can keys be in customer HSM and can logs be retained in-region (eu-west-1) for 5 years? Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM. Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-west-1 under enterprise agreement and KMS addendum; 5-year retention is large but can be handled with export-to-customer-archive or extended retention add-on. I'll draft formal answer.

ben_salesops: ballpark Dedicated for their load (40k tokens/day steady with burst) is ~Zk/mo, reserve min 4 GPUs. I'll pull finance for exact quote and a month-to-month reserved option.

ci-bot: [ci 2051.2] stream-sanitize-fallback branch built. unit tests: \u2705, integration: \u2705. staging deploy queued.

mira_engineer: canary plan: add `vertex-45` to canary routing, bump per-client burst tokens to 180 for repro window, monitor. Sam, can you take care of that?

sam_oncall: added vertex-45 to canary and increased burst for 4 hours. Dash: https://console.redwood/integrations/vertex-45/streams.

alex_sales: customer will repro tonight 18:00 UTC. They need stable POC this week to close. If canary shows clean JSON + stable QPS, they'll sign.

leo_ml: note: fallback wrapper preserves raw bytes as base64 to avoid data loss. We'll make it opt-in per route. Default stays strict.

mira_engineer: pushing canary now. Will report results in this thread.

benn_salesops: preparing one-pager: steps we took, recommended client config (max-workers=4, jittered backoff), quote and SQ summary.

alex_sales: thanks team. Please update after the canary run. :thumbsup:
